# Lessons

Read at start by every agent: what happened and the rule, newest first. An unenforced `Check:` is the next orchestrator's first task; once landed, shrink it to `Check: enforced by <path>`. Kept under 8 KB.

## 2026-11-01: one key added to the help table broke three literal counts
Check: enforced by tests/e2e_view_help.rs the_table() and help.rs `HELP.len()` (safe-sweep).
undo-and-headings t1: adding `u` failed `keymap_narrows_...` (`5 of 56`), and in the e2e help suite ` of 56` and a 72-row resize sized for the old table. Rule: a new view key updates help.rs's array length and GROUPS count, and runs `cargo test --test e2e_view_help` before it commits.

## 2026-11-01: a forged view.json lost every good mark to one bad field, twice
Judgement: timed-sleep found it for `asleep`, undo-and-headings for `held`, `order`, `shelved` and `axis` (fixed 3671d36, pinned by rows.rs `arranged_a_field_that_does_not_read_costs_that_field_and_not_the_file`). Rule: a new field in view.json reads through `or_default` or an entry-by-entry reader in rows.rs, and its test forges one bad entry beside good ones.

## 2026-11-01: a rule about when a phase began missed prompts read off the screen
Check: enforced by src/main.rs tests::every_read_of_a_records_own_phase_says_what_covers_a_reading_that_disagrees (marks-survive): a production read of `.state.state` or `.state.since` it does not list goes red, and each listed one names its disagreeing-pair test or why it cannot mislead. Repeated in safe-sweep: sweep's second reading kept a Working record over a dead pane, which reads Stopped, so a killed agent was never swept; review caught it.
timed-sleep: early wake compared the record's `since` with the sleep's, but a prompt only the screen shows (codex's approval box) leaves `State.state` working and `since` from before, so the verdict waited while the record never moved. Review caught it. Rule: a rule about when an agent started waiting or failing also handles `view.phase()` disagreeing with `view.state.state`, and its test builds such a view (verdict Waiting over a Working record).

## 2026-10-31: a grouping rule shelved e2e fixtures the unit tests never saw
Judgement: auto-shelve t3/t4: the idle rule passed 580 view unit tests, then the wave suite failed four e2e tests whose fixture records have no `since` (read as 0, idle since 1970), and the merged rule hid rows three `c` tests looked for. timed-sleep repeated it for a row's columns: t5's brief VERIFY ran only `tui::`, and two e2e layout tests went red in the wave. Rule: a task that changes which group a row lands in, or what a row's columns draw, puts this in its VERIFY and runs `cargo test --test e2e_view_wall --test e2e_view_card --test e2e_view_keys --test e2e_resume --test e2e_wall` (about 40 s) before it commits.

## 2026-10-31: a second cargo target dir filled the /tmp quota
Check: enforced by src/main.rs tests::the_suite_builds_outside_tmp.
auto-shelve: a wave run's target dir sat untracked in the repo; moving it to the scratchpad hit the /tmp quota mid-copy. Rule: a wave suite runs in a detached worktree with `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=$HOME/.cache/amx-wave-target`, never a target dir in the repo or /tmp.

## 2026-10-31: the suite run from an amx pane reads the person's own agents
Check: enforced by src/main.rs tests::the_suite_runs_outside_an_amx_pane_over_an_empty_home.
shelve-by-hand: the view's unit tests pass only with HOME pointed at an empty directory and the pane's AMX_*/TMUX unset (facts R6K821AV, C2G0FZ5E); every brief had to carry the scrub. Rule: run tests as `env -u AMX_BIN -u AMX_AGENT_DIR -u AMX_NESTED -u AMX_DIR -u AMX_ID -u TMUX -u TMUX_PANE HOME=$(mktemp -d) CARGO_HOME=~/.cargo RUSTUP_HOME=~/.rustup cargo test`, and paste that line into every implementer and reviewer brief.
